[list]
[*] Fixed the issue which would prevent “Fully Booked” achievement from unlocking - This fix is retroactive and will unlock the achievement if you have fulfilled the criteria

notes.content:
Hello Epic Chefs! 

We've just released a patch on Steam for version 1.0.2. We've cooked up the the below fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue wherein if the player attempts to gather the Erwin Seeds in the forest with a full inventory, the seeds will not respawn.
[*] Fixed an issue wherein 'Prepare to fight Torapio' does not update and therefore cannot be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue wherein duplicates of NPCs in the Nyarian District are visible during the Caturnalia Festival.
[/list]

notes.title: Epic Chef Steam Hotfix 1 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/296ccdf75e0e3090bb11d8cc0f9fa284bb533278.png[/img]

Greetings Chefs!

We've just pulled a fresh Steam Hotfix out of the oven and dished it out for some issues that have been noticed since launch last week!

Here is a list of fixes for this Steam Hotfix:

[list]
[*] If the player swaps restaurant menu dishes with previously occupied empty slots the game will not save correctly
[*] Simplified Chinese - Missing characters / empty squares can be seen in text after ~1hr of gameplay
[*] The player will become softlocked on the construction screen if they try to add a locked item to the shortcut bar
[*] Incorrect quest name is shown for the 'Peel the Magic - Meet Valzoy' Main Quest
[*] Unable to scroll through tabs on the Settings menu with a Controller or Keyboard
[*] Button prompts that appear in tutorial popups do not update dynamically when the input method changes
[*] Some button prompts do not update when swapping control input methods in the 'Wardrobe' menu
[*] Some button prompts do not update when swapping control input methods in the 'Quest' menu
[*] After tabbing with a controller in the in-game settings menu, the controller image will not display
[*] Yard assets disappear upon returning to the yard after using the aerobarge
[*] Various fixes for SFX not being affected by the audio slider
[/list]
We hope this hotfix helps you enjoy your time in Ambrosia even more! If you find any issues, please log them on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1312960/discussions/1/]Report a Problem forum[/url] so the team can investigate!

notes.title: Epic Chef is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/530762045b53bb3587f9295c1ea95cc216a649ec.png[/img]

Greetings fellow chefs! The time has come! We are ready to visit Ambrosia at last! Epic Chef is cooked up and ready to serve and is available now on Steam!

Watch the launch trailer here - Gather round and feast your eyes on it!

https://youtu.be/2yGQjroGguU

Epic Chef will be available on Steam for $24.99 / €24.99 / £19.99

We also have a special loyalty deal for owners of Overcooked, Overcooked 2, Overcooked All You Can Eat and My Time at Portia! If you own any of these games you can grab a cool 20% discount on Epic Chef until November 18th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/34f2569ecb1ad2cdbff055e795e4bb2f3f345351.png[/img]

For details of when Epic Chef launches in your timezone, please refer to this handy guide we cooked up for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941731/85a2b01a9ecf1d69e820935f4bf3f533c22e13b5.png[/img]

A histrionic story-driven adventure, Epic Chef blends together several different genres in order to serve up a unique recipe for players; with farming, foraging, and food fights being a small slice of the action, Ambrosia offers plenty of activities to keep Zest busy from sunrise to sunset. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/c9ce4348833c2bfa15743ae734379b7b5c18e8c2.gif[/img]

Dynamic recipe creation means nothing is off the menu! Craft and experiment with thousands of ingredient combinations, creating the very best – and worst – dishes imaginable, all in an attempt to take down the competition. 

[b]Key features 
[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Story Time:[/b] A wonderfully crafted narrative unfolds as players journey to become the very best chef in Ambrosia 

[*] [b]Delicious Dishes:[/b] Dynamic recipe creation means that players can experiment with thousands of different ingredient combinations to create a unique menu of delicious delights 

[*] [b]Food Fights:[/b] Engage in battles across Ambrosia with master chefs; dishes are scored on a variety of things and no two judges have the same taste, meaning every battle is different 

[*] [b]Home Sweet Home:[/b] Customise and repair the dilapidated (and slightly haunted) villa Zest calls home to its former glory 

[*] [b]Discover Ambrosia:[/b] When the kitchen gets a little too hot players can go on spa trips, try fishing, or meet the friendly locals. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/61de15c45456faa5f07e03703b42efd00321a26f.gif[/img]

Grab your spatula and start on a journey to become Epic…. Chef. 
 
[b]Get your ticket to Ambrosia booked right now by getting Epic Chef now! 
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1312960/Epic_Chef/ 

To keep up to date with all the information on Epic Chef, go to www.visitambrosia.com – the official website of the Concordian Tourism Board – like us on [url=http://facebook.com/EpicChefGame]Facebook[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/epicchefgame]Twitter[/url] and join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/team17]Discord[/url].

Zest has prepared a delicious trailer for you to enjoy: 

https://youtu.be/4IRdyfKe9p4
Fresh off the boat, new to the city of Ambrosia, and playing as Zest, you will find yourself on a quest to become the best chef in the kingdom, taking down master chefs in outlan-dish culinary combat along the way. 

A histrionic story-driven adventure, Epic Chef blends together several different genres in order to serve up a unique recipe for players; with farming, foraging, and food fights being a small slice of the action, Ambrosia offers plenty of activities to keep Zest busy from sunrise to sunset. 

Dynamic recipe creation means nothing is off the menu! Craft and experiment with thousands of ingredient combinations, creating the very best – and worst – dishes imaginable, all in an attempt to take down the competition. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/9a0dc956e5077c18f3eaad2b5ee26dfe396da821.gif[/img]

[b]Key features 
[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Story Time:[/b] A wonderfully crafted narrative unfolds as players journey to become the very best chef in Ambrosia 

[*] [b]Delicious Dishes:[/b] Dynamic recipe creation means that players can experiment with thousands of different ingredient combinations to create a unique menu of delicious delights 

[*] [b]Food Fights:[/b] Engage in battles across Ambrosia with master chefs; dishes are scored on a variety of things and no two judges have the same taste, meaning every battle is different 

[*] [b]Home Sweet Home:[/b] Customise and repair the dilapidated (and slightly haunted) villa Zest calls home to its former glory 

[*] [b]Discover Ambrosia:[/b] When the kitchen gets a little too hot players can go on spa trips, try fishing, or meet the friendly locals. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/9bb552e2834042d17a5a7343f8947f9c5b840aa9.gif[/img]

Grab your spatula and start on a journey to become Epic…. Chef. 
 
[b]Get your ticket to Ambrosia booked right now by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.content:
Greetings Chefs!

It's that time again! Get ready for our Flavour Of The Month Dev Diary, this time we're looking at the more spooky elements of Epic Chef! [b] Please Note: Some elements contained within these screenshots are still in Development and as such, may not resemble the final versions! [/b] With that said, on with the Dev Diary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/f1224fa8949a3be4697ebdc0212beb9c9e9dc908.png[/img]

[h1] [b] The Grounds Of Zest's Cliffhanger Villa [/b] [/h1]

Upon entering the ground's of Zest's Cliffhanger Villa, there are many spooky goings on that lurk in the shadows. tricky thorns, towering trees, eerie eyes, ghastly guillotines, shocking stocks and more!

[i] Take a trip through the grounds!... [/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jAcX2O4.gif[/img]

There are some very [i] interesting [/i] additions to the grounds of Zest's Cliffhanger Villa!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/83adc1a21884bcb63e50c24ff43c3bb82c27e38c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/8c60f31cd6c493312429e4e67c530cee4c0082fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/b31398d4ffb7baf3aa03b0c6006b88aa41c5819b.png[/img]

Following the main path through the grounds leads to Zest's Cliffhanger Villa! With some work it will be a cosy place to live, just try not to think about the curse, *AHEM* we [i] mean [/i] those [i] accursed [/i] cobwebs as the Villa has been empty a while!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/5f9a98cf10e6d4fd13ea87b847b32ef3f15c5174.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/a3245c17f6a01535fad18d16ed9e5399690c2d05.png[/img]

[h1] [b] Critic's Union [/b] [/h1]

But the undead and their curses pale in comparison to the true terror of all the chefs in the city. Their most feared nightmares lurk elsewhere...

Zest will get to meet some more magically inclined folks on his adventures in Ambrosia! This is the Magic Shop, but which Witch which should you trust?

notes.title: Flavour of the Month Dev Log – August Edition!
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!

It's that time again! Get ready for our Flavour Of The Month, this one is all about our new Mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/6af528a5f5ff10e52d8baff5d0bee951b30d4ae8.png[/img]

Everyone tip your chef hats and give a warm welcome to [b] Birch! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/80e3e53f7d0e7f006ec4e6538b08daa8fe8ba2d8.png[/img]

This mount can carry items in it's saddlebag, perfect for portable pocket storage! This Saddlebag allows players to extend their storage on the move. This makes harvesting items a breeze when heading out and exploring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/a9d819f9f3d99ed12e5b391b4abf4befc03dc92b.png[/img]

You can call your mount at any moment, and it will be tele-transported to your location, talk about fast travel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/a82a7640791c8c39c7c9739562d797f718013af0.jpg[/img]

Make sure to take care of your mount, or it will not allow you to ride it. If you feed your mount their favourite food, their stats will increase! This will also in turn make your mount both faster and stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/c2ed03bd42d912adac22a812d4c25f8bc2f042d4.png[/img]
[b] Birch [/b] says thank you to all our Chefs for reading August's Flavour Of The Month!

notes.title: Flavour of the Month Dev Log – July Edition!
notes.content:
Welcome Chefs!

Dash into your kitchen, whip up your favourite brew and get ready for our “Flavour Of The Month!” July Edition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/f972728316071ce091f055cb85b0a44518557788.png[/img]

We are delighted to serve up another Dev Diary, with the flavour of the month being our Art Uplift! Our main course will focus on our new Art Uplift, followed by a side dish of new farm buildings with new animal teasers for refreshments!

[b] [h1] Art Uplift [/h1] [/b]

Establishing Epic Chef’s identity and bringing the game alive has been very important to us. We have made several art changes to achieve a more “[b]toonish[/b]” and stylized look and feel to the game. Here is a comparison GIF showing off our “Old” and “New” art upgrades to Epic Chef. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/7aa5d1d4fcdcba48565e80a5bb5ef6047a215132.gif[/img]

Feast your eyes on these full sized screenshots showing off our new art style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/cbe151fd22ab0c84bde5ea7e86b71f78999095ab.png[/img]
[i] Previous In Game Style [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/97e7c816fdd31e1f87c8248e159741c17d2b2e1c.png[/img]
[i] New Art Uplift Style [/i]

We have also been working on a new “[b]outline effect[/b]”. This has been added to increase detail in scenarios and for the characters to stand out. Below are a few examples that show our new outline effect and Art Uplift changes too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/4b4a6332ab0b0d7de93aa3e2e45a56c6f54897c1.png[/img]
[i] Outline Effects On Characters [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/7742243763fcfafeefa34894d23c7deb55001fe4.png[/img]
[i] What a lovely view! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/830fcb65cad3d1094c424bd5ebf97f08fd099c08.png[/img]
[i] Colourful scenery from high above! [/i]

[b] [h1] New Farm Buildings [/h1] [/b]

We have been working on new additions for farming life! New buildings and objects can be built onto farm land, below is a teaser for our [b] Windmill [/b]. Windmills are used to produce seeds for your farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/5670cb6257a95f28357cdc97f84f07bf159a2252.png[/img]
[i] Note: The orange hue of the building shows that an object is in “building mode” before it is placed. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/22b97d2e63441029a1173987896f98342dedee4f.png[/img]
[i] Sweet and juicy! Tomatoes can be used in lots of recipes in Epic Chef! So make sure to plant plenty of Tomato seeds! [/i]

[b] [h1] New Animals [/h1] [/b]

New animals have been sighted in Ambrosia! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/50cc495de867546709e44198a18cdffe7dd3a02d.png[/img]
[i] What a magnificent menagerie! [/i]

On the left is a [b]Giant Turtle[/b], with the most fabulous eyebrows we have ever seen, in the middle is a [b]Pangun[/b] and on the right are 2 [b]Unicorns[/b]! If you look closely, you can see some pink glittery “[b]Unicorn Delights[/b]”, this is [b][i]*ahem*[/i][/b] “produced” by Unicorns, and makes for a fine ingredient in some recipes! Mmmm, delicious! [b]Turtle Meat[/b] and [b]Unicorn Meat[/b] are also ingredients used in cooking delectable dishes. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/c8d5bfbb4e6c13f14889463927d6a15e934a08c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/49daf34c8328f090c262f7bcdcd3511639a1541b.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/731b8edf51853b4be83722aea0f573ddad05362e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/09d81b6af53593fcd39ebd258294548f0293fba6.png[/img][/url]
[i] Here are the Inventory icons for [b]Turtle Meat[/b] and [b]Unicorn Meat![/b] [/i]

That’s a wrap for this month’s tasty Dev Log! We will see you next month, Chefs!

notes.title: Introducing Epic Chef!
notes.content:
[b]Order up![/b]

We are so excited to announce that we’ve partnered with Infinigon to bring you Epic Chef - a quirky, tasty blend of life sim, crafting and culinary chaos!
Check out the taste bud tingling trailer below!

[previewyoutube=11Je_LeVt8g;full][/previewyoutube]

In Epic Chef you take on the role of Zest, who must embark on a culinary journey to farm, craft and cook his way into legend!

[h2][b]Key Features:[/b][/h2]
[b]Create Delicious Dishes! [/b]
Dynamic recipe creation means that you can experiment with thousands of different ingredient combinations to create a unique menu of delicious delights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/9bb552e2834042d17a5a7343f8947f9c5b840aa9.gif[/img]

[b]Chef Battles! [/b]
Take on rival chefs in epic culinary clashes to be crowned cooking king! Dishes are scored on a variety of things and no two judges have the same taste - meaning every battle is different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/9a0dc956e5077c18f3eaad2b5ee26dfe396da821.gif[/img]

[b]Home on the range![/b]
Live off your land by growing food such as fruit and vegetables, as well as tending to an eclectic mix of animals from cows to unicorns! You'll also need to repair and customise your dilapidated (and slightly haunted) mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/61de15c45456faa5f07e03703b42efd00321a26f.gif[/img]

[b]Crafty Cook! [/b]
A chef is only as good as their tools. Gather resources to craft specialised machinery that can process your ingredients, and even create new recipe components!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/082659ec826e9ffdbddb18f4a03c7cda943f2677.gif[/img]

[b]Explore Ambrosia![/b]
You are free to explore all that the city has to offer. Visit various locations such as the tavern, the spa or try your hand at fishing. Meet the friendly locals and make them hate you less with the power of food.
Epic Chef will be coming to Steam! Wishlist it now! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/c9ce4348833c2bfa15743ae734379b7b5c18e8c2.gif[/img]

[b]Tale as old as thyme![/b]
Enjoy a humorous story, with an elaborate cast of characters, all woven into a world inspired by the writing of Sir Terry Pratchett.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37900659/5ce49390ac1465c14f12bc330608b7811101a581.gif[/img]
